name: ASBO Matrix
description: All Star bulk quantity pricing matrix for normal WooCommerce product templates.
changelog:
0.1.0

  • Adds the ASBO Matrix Gutenberg block for normal WooCommerce product templates.
  • Renders nothing and changes no pricing when the current product has no valid ASBO pricing matrix.
  • Shows WooCommerce Regular Price at 1+, the configured ASBO bulk thresholds, 10K stitch allowance, optional decoration selector, and live tier highlighting.
  • Marks normal product-page cart items with production-compatible ASBO metadata so the existing ASBO cart pricing engine applies the same combined-quantity tiers across variations.
  • Supports Wide/Full alignment and native block spacing controls.
